journal.action: PlaneMap/Jordan and the conditional degree-five Kempe stack compile without sorry. Euler, the edge bound, degree at most five, neighbour rotation, even_is_face_sum, cycleEdgeCoeff_is_face_sum, local no-cross separation, and five_color_degree_five under hopposite are Lean theorems. The complete Lean Five Colour Theorem remains open on the connected Kempe-cycle bridge and vertex-deletion induction carrier. This is not the Four Colour Theorem.

node.title: Lean PlaneMap core
node.statement: Generated combinatorial plane maps satisfy Euler's formula, the planar edge bound, a degree-at-most-five lemma, triangulation counts, and neighbour rotation.
node.approach: Rotation systems with faces as faceNext orbits; constructor induction on Vertex, Grow, and Split.
node.killCriteria: A build failure, a forbidden placeholder, or a constructor that violates a stated count.

notes.text: Critic gate accepted the compiled core. This is infrastructure, not a colouring theorem.

node.evidence: Current Mathlib build exits 0. Cycle maps and the tetrahedron are constructor-checked. No sorry, admit, or axiom.

node.title: Even sets and local combinatorial Jordan separation
node.statement: Every even edge combination is a mod-two sum of face boundaries; cycle edges are such a sum; its face-sum sides have no cross edge and are preserved by avoiding walks.
node.approach: Constructor induction for even_is_face_sum, followed by face-coefficient propagation.
node.killCriteria: A generated PlaneMap with an even edge set not in the face-boundary span, or a cross edge between the defined sum-sides.

notes.text: The current CycleCut may be disconnected; no global reachability partition is claimed.

node.evidence: even_is_face_sum, cycleEdgeCoeff_is_face_sum, no_cross_edge_sum_sides, and walk_stays_on_sum_side compile. JordanTwoSides top build exits 0.

node.title: Connected Kempe-cycle separation bridge
node.statement: A bichromatic path between the first opposite neighbour pair at a degree-five vertex creates a connected cycle that separates the second opposite pair, yielding hopposite.
node.approach: Construct ConnectedCycleCut from Walk.IsCycle, relate opposite rotation sectors to opposite face-sum coefficients, then rule out an avoiding bichromatic path.
node.killCriteria: A valid degree-five plane-map configuration satisfying the hypotheses but admitting both opposite bichromatic connections.

notes.text: Use a connected cycle API; do not assert cycle_two_sides for every current CycleCut.

node.evidence: Inputs already compile: cycleEdgeCoeff_is_face_sum, opposite_sectors_of_pentagon, no_cross_edge_sum_sides, and five_color_degree_five under hopposite.

node.title: PlaneMap deletion and component induction
node.statement: After deleting a low-degree vertex, every connected component inherits a smaller generated plane map and the component colourings assemble into a proper colouring of the deleted graph.
node.approach: Prototype component restriction, a disconnected spherical-map carrier, and direct Generated deletion closure; select one at a critic design gate.
node.killCriteria: The proposed carrier assumes deletion preserves connectedness or introduces planarity/generatedness as an axiom.

notes.text: This is the largest remaining infrastructure task for the Lean Five Colour induction.

node.evidence: No delete/induce theorem currently exists under SimpleGraph/PlaneMap. The plan requires a compiling design prototype before a proof implementation.

node.title: Five Colour Theorem in Lean
node.statement: Every generated PlaneMap with face lengths at least three has a proper Fin 5 vertex colouring.
node.approach: Strong induction after the connected Kempe-cycle bridge and deletion/component carrier compile.
node.killCriteria: A remaining assumption in the final theorem named hopposite, cycle_two_sides, IsPlanar, or Triangulation; or a forbidden proof placeholder.
